hook.text: Whiskey is beer that's been distilled. Distillation concentrates alcohol from 5% to 60–70% by exploiting different boiling points.

buildup.text: Ethanol boils at 78.4°C; water at 100°C. Heating a mixture to 78–100°C vaporizes more alcohol than water.

discovery.text: Pot stills (batch) produce complex spirits—whiskey, cognac. Column stills (continuous) produce pure, neutral spirits—vodka.

twist.text: Essential oil extraction from herbs uses steam distillation—steam carries volatile oils from plant material, then condenses into.

climax.text: Fractional distillation of crude oil uses the same principle—separating by boiling point.

quiz.question: Why does distillation concentrate alcohol?
options: Ethanol boils at 78.4°C (lower than water)—so more alcohol vaporizes when heated
